messages:
lena: Hey team - Centrise Health is asking for SOC2/ISO artifacts + a signed pen-test letter before the POC kickoff. They also want to understand any SLA/pricing impact if we move to Dedicated for isolation. Can security confirm what we can share and timing?
sam_sec: We can share SOC2 report summary and control mapping (no raw logs). Pen-test letter: security can sign, need the customer legal contact and scope. Is Centrise asking for on-prem or VPC Dedicated?
lena: They want Dedicated (VPC) for the POC. They emphasized data residency in EU. Also asked about SSO + KMS key separation notes.
mike_eng: For Dedicated, there's a lead time (~4-6 weeks) to provision EU capacity if capacity pool is needed. Pricing will be quoted as reserved capacity; short POC bursts can use burst capacity but it's additional. I can pull estimated cost tiers.
anya_cs: I'll draft the evidence bundle and request staging creds. Can someone confirm the minimum artifacts we should put in the dropbox?
sam_sec: Minimum: SOC2 Type II attestation PDF (redacted), control matrix mapping to our features, network diagram for Dedicated deployment, encryption architecture doc (KMS flow), SSO/SCIM integration notes, pen-test signoff letter template. We don't provide raw penetration test reports unless NDA'd.
lena: Perfect. Customer legal point: julia@centrise.com. Can we send a pen-test letter template to them to get signed?
sam_sec: Yes. I'll attach the template to the evidence drive and send a signed copy once legal approves. ETA by EOD tomorrow.
mike_eng: Related note: for the KMS separation ask, our docs explain BYOK flow and HSM integr. I'll drop that link in the drive. Also flag: if they require on-prem connector for air-gapped data, that's a separate engineering eval.
lena: Timeline ask from Centrise: need evidence + signed pen-test by next Wednesday to hit their internal compliance window. Can we make that?
 sam_sec: Tight but doable. I'll prioritize the pen-test letter. For SOC2 attestation, we can share the latest PDF now. Control matrix may need a day.
anya_cs: I'll create the Dropbox folder and invite julia@centrise.com plus our distro. Link: https://drive.company/evidence/centrise-poc (placeholder). I'll upload what we have and tag missing items.
lena: Great. Also they asked whether evidence exchange impacts SLA - we should state that dedicated provisioning may change lead time but not baseline SLA once provisioned. Mike can confirm exact numbers.
mike_eng: Confirmed — once Dedicated is provisioned, SLA same as hosted (we'll include latency/uptime numbers). Provisioning lead time and any burst costs will be spelled out in the quote.
lena: Ok action items: sam_sec to upload pen-test letter template and SOC2 PDF (by EOD tomorrow). anya_cs to create drive and invite customer (today). mike_eng to provide provisioning lead time + pricing delta (tomorrow). I'll loop in legal if we need redlines. :thumbsup:
evidence-bot: Evidence folder created: https://drive.company/evidence/centrise-poc - invited: julia@centrise.com; notifications sent.
lena: Thanks everyone — I'll update Centrise with the plan and timeline now.
